definitions.predictor: Gibbs risk for Gaussian-posterior methods; deterministic predictor for ERM/L2. Each sampled weight is fixed for a full test pass.
definitions.loss: -log(0.01+0.99*p_y)/log(100), in [0,1]; all reported risks and RHSs use this same loss.
definitions.test_risk: Ten-draw held-out estimate on the official 10,000-example test set under deployment channels; not the known population risk.
definitions.empirical_risk: Same frozen checkpoint on all training examples with the saved reused channel bank; not the average training trajectory loss.
definitions.uncertainty: Mean +/- sample SD over all validation-selected initialization/channel-bank seeds, conditional on the fixed data.
definitions.nominal_rhs: Unweighted empirical risk + T1 channel/data or T2 joint complexity + bounded-loss channel shift at the saved nominal delta. Training eta coefficients never scale these terms.
definitions.corrected_risk_rhs: min(1, empirical MC estimate + its upper correction) + unweighted T1 channel/data or T2 joint complexity + bounded-loss shift, using overall delta .05 across 51 selected runs: theorem failure .04/(2*51), MC failure .01/51. Displayed before final clipping so vacuity is visible; final clipping to the loss range gives the trivial bound one whenever the RHS exceeds one.
definitions.complexity_shift_floor: Nonnegative part of the nominal risk-bound RHS before empirical risk. It is not a lower bound on true population risk.
definitions.bound_status: Vacuous means complexity+shift alone exceeds one for every seed. Missing empirical risk is not replaced by zero. N/A means a Dirac posterior has infinite KL to the continuous Gaussian prior.
definitions.certificate_limit: Nominal complexity terms remain diagnostics. Corrected rows include fresh bank-risk Monte Carlo control and the declared 51-run confidence allocation, conditional on theorem assumptions and the declared candidate family; they do not certify classification error or unbounded CE.
definitions.pending_queue: Run each entry's argument-vector command from repository root only after saved checkpoint files and DATASET are available. The bank evaluator has no training fallback.
